stories.title: NASA Seeks Next Generation of Explorers to Join Astronaut Corps
stories.excerpt: NASA is looking for the explorers who will help write the next chapter of human spaceflight. stories.title: M30’s Sparkling Stars
stories.excerpt: This NASA/ESA Hubble Space Telescope image released Nov. 5, 2026, provides a lesson in galactic history. The sparkling collection of stars is named Messier 30 (M30) after the French astronomer, Charles Messier, who cataloged M30 and other diffuse objects that might be mistaken for comets in the early telescopes of Messier’s time.
